text: はじめの　うちは　ポケモンを　よわらせてから　とるのが　コツじゃぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　よわらせてから

patterns.name: 〜てから
patterns.explanation: から after a て-form verb means 'after doing that'. よわらせてから = 'after weakening it'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. とるのが コツ = 'catching it is the trick'.

patterns.name: 〜うちは
patterns.explanation: うちは means 'during the time that'. はじめの うちは = 'while you are still at the beginning'.
